text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 9.1% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 6.7%, signaling that risk appetite has deteriorated across both majors and alt-layer tokens. The Fear & Greed Index at 13 (extreme fear) and worsening over the past week reflects widespread panic selling, yet Bitcoin dominance climbing to 58.8% suggests traders are rotating into the perceived safer major rather than exiting crypto entirely. Volume at $97B indicates active liquidation rather than apathy, pointing to a sharp sentiment reversal but not necessarily capitulation across the market.
